items.title: Drone attacks on energy infrastructure deepen Libya’s energy crisis
items.summary: Repeated drone strikes on oil and power infrastructure are deepening Libya's energy crisis.

items.title: Israeli air strike kills one in northern Gaza
items.summary: Strike on a tuk-tuk in Beit Lahiya kills one, wounds five in first Israeli aerial bombardment in a week

items.title: Iran: US ‘unprecedented violations’ of Geneva Conventions cannot be ignored
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has condemned the US threats and airstrikes against Iran’s civilian infrastructure as clear war crimes, and warned that normalizing such "unprecedented violations" of the Geneva Conventions would erode the international legal order.

items.title: Daily Press Briefing by the Office of the Spokesperson for the Secretary-General
items.summary: Since the Taliban takeover in August 2021, Afghanistan has systematically dismantled the rights of women — half its population — making it a global outlier with no parallel in the modern world, UN-Women reports. Half of Afghan women interviewed leave home only once or twice a month due to severe restrictions.

items.title: Drought exposes Nazi-era warship wrecks beneath the Danube
items.summary: Record-low water levels on the Danube near Prahovo, Serbia, have exposed the wrecks of dozens of Nazi-era vessels

items.title: Iranian FM holds talks with Pakistani interior minister in Mashhad
items.summary: Mashhad, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi meets with Pakistani Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Naqvi in Mashhad, holding talks as the Pakistani official visits the city to pay homage at the holy shrine of Imam Reza (AS).

items.title: Is Russia’s economy cracking despite the Iran war windfall?
items.summary: A widening deficit and Ukrainian strikes are testing Russia's economy, even as war in the Middle East lifts oil revenue.
